![The Mac asked by the PS5](docs/screenshots/computer-quick-connect-request.png) | ### The web app, in a browser The same pages whichever device serves them: a computer, a PS5 or a Switch. | | | |---|---| | **FTP / SFTP client** (here on a Mac, connected to a PS5)
![The web app's client](docs/screenshots/web-client.png) | **Files** (here served by a PS5: its drives)
![The web app's file manager on a PS5](docs/screenshots/web-files.png) | ## Known gaps - **Switch: save data and system storage** (NAND) aren't reachable. - **The SFTP server is on computers only**; the consoles' server is FTP. - **Mac**: macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon only, and not notarized (see [Windows, Mac and Linux](#windows-mac-and-linux)). ## Building ```sh make PLATFORM=sdl # ./chiral-ftp, a window on this computer (default) make PLATFORM=ps5 # dist/PPSA96024/ and its zip make PLATFORM=switch # dist/chiral-ftp/chiral-ftp.nro make PLATFORM=ps5 release # adds the PS5 zip to release/, with SHA256SUMS make PLATFORM=switch release # and the Switch .nro; the notes cover both make test # unit tests, and a check that every platform is complete ``` Everything shared lives in `engine/`, `web/` and `app/`; what differs lives in `platform//`. [docs/LAYOUT.md](docs/LAYOUT.md) explains how, and [docs/PORTING.md](docs/PORTING.md) is the history of getting there. **PS5** is built on macOS (Linux should work with minor changes) with the tooling of [ps5-native-app-boilerplate](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ps5-native-app-boilerplate), included in `ps5/`: 1. `brew install llvm@18 coreutils gnu-sed bash cmake sdl2 libmicrohttpd` 2. Build the boilerplate's tooling once: `cd ps5 && make` (on macOS, the wrappers in `ps5/.hostbin` and the Homebrew GNU tools must be on `PATH`). 3. `make PLATFORM=ps5`. The first run fetches and builds mbedTLS, libssh2 and libmicrohttpd for the PS5 (checksums pinned in `tools/build-ps5-deps.sh`), and the Lapy helper. 4. `make PLATFORM=ps5 deploy PS5_HOST=` sends the build to the PS5 through an FTP server that runs outside the app's sandbox (ftpsrv on port 2121). Only changed files are sent, each is verified and renamed into place, and everything is set to 777. **Switch** needs [devkitPro](https://devkitpro.org/wiki/Getting_Started): ```sh dkp-pacman -S switch-dev switch-libssh2 switch-mbedtls switch-zlib dkp-toolchain-vars export DEVKITPRO=/opt/devkitpro ``` devkitPro has no package for libmicrohttpd, which the web app needs, so the first build cross-compiles it into `.deps/switch` (checksum pinned). `make PLATFORM=switch WEB=0` leaves the web app out and drops that dependency. **PC and Mac** need SDL2, libmicrohttpd and pkg-config, plus `tools/build-sftp-deps.sh host` for libssh2 and mbedTLS. **Windows** builds in [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org): the UCRT64 shell for x64, CLANGARM64 for arm64 (use `mingw-w64-clang-aarch64-` instead of `mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-` below). Everything is linked statically, so the result is one `.exe` that needs nothing installed beside it. ```sh pacman -S make mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-{gcc,pkgconf,cmake,ninja,python,SDL2,libmicrohttpd,libssh,freetype} CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja bash -o igncr tools/build-sftp-deps.sh host make PLATFORM=sdl dist # dist/chiral-ftp--windows-x64.exe make PLATFORM=sdl release # and adds it to release/ ``` The shared code is written against POSIX; `platform/sdl/win32/posix.h` gives it that on Windows, with paths as MSYS2 writes them (`/c/Users`, and `/` for the list of drives). The generators are Python 3; if your `python3` is called something else, pass it: `make PYTHON=python`. `tools/render-icon.py` regenerates the Switch icon, and `tools/render-background.sh` the PS5's dashboard background. **Translations** live in [i18n/translations.json](i18n/translations.json): every string the app shows, in English and the eight other languages. The build refuses a string with no entry, a missing language, or a translation whose placeholders (`{0}`, `%s`) differ from the English. Corrections from native speakers are very welcome. ## Bugs and contributions Found a bug? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/issues). Say what you did, what happened, which console (with its firmware and jailbreak or custom firmware), and if possible the startup log: `/data/chiral-ftp/startup.log` on the PS5, `/switch/chiral-ftp/startup.log` on the Switch. [Pull requests](https://github.com/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/pulls) are welcome. ## Thanks chiral-ftp stands on the work of others. Thank you: **PS5** - **[ps5-native-app-boilerplate](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ps5-native-app-boilerplate)** by BlackBearReloaded. It is how chiral-ftp exists as a native dashboard title at all. We use its toolchain unchanged (included in `ps5/`): the compiler wrapper, the link script and program startup code, the tool that converts and signs `eboot.bin`, and its clean-room `libc.prx` runtime, which ships in `sce_module/`. The code that sets up the TV display follows its VideoOut example, and its notes on what a sandboxed title may and may not do (sockets, `fcntl`, name lookups) saved us a lot of trial and error. - **[ProsperoEden](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden)** by BlackBearReloaded and contributors. Its storage access client (`platform/ps5/elevation/`) is used as is, with one change: chiral-ftp also checks that the app really became root before trusting what it can see. We also follow its approach to listing folders on the PS5 (reading directories with `sceKernelGetdents` and a large buffer), its link recipe for the C++ runtime, and how it talks to the system keyboard. - **[PS5-Lapy-JB-Daemon](https://github.com/ArkSama/PS5-Lapy-JB-Daemon)** (Lapy) by ArkSama, with the cooperative one-shot helper from [mpereiraesaa's fork](https://github.com/mpereiraesaa/PS5-Lapy-JB-Daemon), pinned through BlackBearReloaded's fork. The packaged `lapy.elf` is built from their unmodified source; at startup chiral-ftp sends it to the ELF loader, and it gives the app access to the console's real storage. That is what lets the file manager, the FTP server and the web app reach your files. - The **[PS5 Payload SDK](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/sdk)**: its compiler, linker and system libraries build the PS5 app, its libraries and the Lapy helper. **Switch** - **[libnx](https://github.com/switchbrew/libnx)** and **[devkitPro](https://devkitpro.org)** by the switchbrew authors, fincs, WinterMute and contributors. The whole console layer is libnx: the framebuffer, the controllers and touch screen, the system keyboard, the fonts and the network, plus the toolchain and libraries the app is built with. - **[ftpd](https://github.com/mtheall/ftpd)** by Michael Theall. Its `source/switch/init.c` is where the Switch's service startup comes from: which services to open, holding off sleep and exit while a transfer runs, and the network buffer settings that make transfers fast. - **[NX-Shell](https://github.com/joel16/NX-Shell)** by Joel16, the model for how the app uses the system keyboard and the SD card. - **[libusbhsfs](https://github.com/DarkMatterCore/libusbhsfs)** by DarkMatterCore, built into the Switch app, with **[NTFS-3G](https://github.com/tuxera/ntfs-3g)** and **[lwext4](https://github.com/gkostka/lwext4)**: they read USB drives (FAT, exFAT, NTFS, ext2/3/4). **Everywhere** - **[websrv](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/websrv)** by John Törnblom. The web app's embedded-file server comes from it: `web/asset.c`, `web/asset.h` and `tools/gen-asset-module.py`, which turn the web pages into C arrays served from memory (we added compressed files). Our libmicrohttpd setup follows websrv and [ps5-web-file-manager](https://github.com/owendswang/ps5-web-file-manager). Also: [ftpsrv](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/ftpsrv) by John Törnblom, whose command set our FTP server follows (our code is written separately); [FileZilla](https://filezilla-project.org), whose behaviour the client follows; and the libraries built into the app: libssh2, Mbed TLS, GNU libmicrohttpd, Dear ImGui, Noto Sans and IBM Plex Mono, and on computers SDL2, libssh (the SFTP server) and FreeType (text). ## License chiral-ftp is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Files taken from other projects keep their original copyright headers. The licenses of everything bundled in the app are in its `licenses` folder (GPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, OFL). Made by **Herbrax** (Simo Hakim): [simohakim.com](https://simohakim.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/simo-hakim/)

latestRelease.body:
# chiral-ftp 1.1

[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/v1.1/total?color=D9B65E&label=downloads)](https://github.com/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/releases/tag/v1.1) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Herbrax/chiral-ftp?color=D9B65E&label=stars)](https://github.com/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/stargazers)

chiral-ftp now has downloads for **Windows**, **Mac** and **Linux**, next to
the **PS5** and the **Nintendo Switch**. And every copy of chiral-ftp on
your network can now find and open the others in two presses: **Quick
connect**.

### New: Quick connect

![Quick connect on a Mac: the devices nearby](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Herbrax/chiral-ftp/main/docs/screenshots/quick-connect-devices.png)

- **Every copy of chiral-ftp on your network shows up**, whatever it is
  doing: no server has to be running, and nothing has to be set up.
- **Ask one to share.** It shows your request with a 4-digit code; check
  it's the same code on both screens and press **Allow**. The other device
  starts its server, and you are connected and browsing it.
- **The login it hands out works only from the device that asked**, and only
  while that server runs. Deny, or let the request time out, and nothing is
  shared.
- On a console, Quick connect is on the start screen (press **Up**) and runs
  while chiral-ftp is open there. On a computer it's in the sidebar (or
  **⌘K** on a Mac) and runs whenever the app is open.
- The list stays current even on Wi-Fi that drops broadcasts.

### New: Windows, Mac and Linux

- **Windows**: one `.exe` (x64; it runs on Windows on ARM too), nothing to
  install. **Mac**: `chiral-ftp.app`. Double-click it, or drag it to
  Applications; it carries its own libraries. **Linux**: one `.AppImage`
  file.
- **Made for a computer** (Windows, Mac and Linux alike): a sidebar with
  the server, the web app, Quick connect, the message log and Settings, each
  a page with ordinary switches, fields and buttons; on a Mac the menu bar
  has everything, with shortcuts.
- **The mouse works everywhere**: hover, click, right-click, scroll, and
  click outside a panel to close it.
- **Sharp text**: the layout follows the window instead of scaling a fixed
  screen, and text is rendered with hinting.
- **SFTP server** (encrypted, the default) or FTP, on the same screen.
- **Shares your home folder** by default. **Whole computer** shares
  everything, after a confirmation. chiral-ftp's own settings (saved
  passwords, the server's login and its private key) are never shared,
  whatever folder is.
- **The web app opens in your browser.** By default only this computer can
  reach it; switch "Reachable from" to your home network to use it from a
  phone or another device.
- **Network**: when a computer is on several networks (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, a
  VPN), Settings > Network chooses the address to show. Automatic prefers
  your home network.
- On a computer, the file manager and the FTP / SFTP client are in the web
  app, in your browser.

### New on the Switch: USB drives

- **USB drives show up in the drive list** as soon as they're plugged in:
  FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4. Browse, copy and move between them and
  the SD card in the file manager, and reach them over the FTP server
  (`/usb0`) and the web app.
- **Free space is shown again** for the SD card and for USB drives.

### New on the PS5

- **Free space is shown** for the internal storage, an M.2 drive and USB
  drives.
- The start screen says how the app got full storage access (the
  jailbreak's resident service, or the Lapy helper), or why it didn't.

### Everywhere

- **Change permissions recursively**: a folder and everything inside it,
  as its own entry next to Change permissions (client, file manager and web
  app). Folders keep x wherever they get r, so they stay openable.
- **Uploads to a PS5 homebrew folder end up 777** (files and folders, any
  path with `/data/homebrew` in it, whichever FTP server the PS5 runs), so
  homebrew copied from another device starts.
- **Rename, permissions and Delete for folders** in the client's menu on
  consoles (OPTIONS on the PS5, Plus on the Switch), for the item under the
  cursor or everything marked.
- **A server that stops answering is let go after 30 seconds**: the client
  says the connection was lost and closes, instead of still saying
  "Connected to…".

### Fixes

- **Switch: closing chiral-ftp during a transfer no longer crashes it**:
  transfers are stopped and waited for before the app exits.
- **Switch: tapping a card no longer opens Quick connect** when the
  controller's focus was on the Quick connect button.
- **Client: pressing Open again while a folder is loading** no longer sends
  the same request again behind the first.
- **Client: the loading spinner no longer covers Disconnect.**
- **Long drive names** no longer run into the path next to them.
- **Computers: folders made by the server, the web app or the file manager
  can be opened** (they were created without the x bit).
- **PS5: the start screen showed the Switch's wording** for full access.

### Install

**PS5**

1. Download `chiral-ftp-ps5-1.1.zip` below and unpack it: it contains
   the folder `PPSA96024`.
2. Copy that folder to `/data/homebrew/PPSA96024` on the PS5.
3. Make sure the folder and every file in it are 777 (the zip stores them
   that way, but some FTP clients don't keep it), then start Chiral-FTP from
   the dashboard.

Updating: close chiral-ftp first, then replace the folder. Your settings and
saved sites stay in `/data/chiral-ftp`.

**Nintendo Switch**

1. Download `chiral-ftp.nro` below.
2. Copy it into `/switch` on your SD card.
3. Start it from hbmenu. For the whole console's memory, hold **R** while
   launching a game and pick chiral-ftp from the menu that opens; starting it
   from the album works too, with less memory.

Updating: replace the `.nro`. Your settings and saved sites stay in
`/switch/chiral-ftp`.

**Mac** (macOS 27 or later, Apple silicon)

1. Download `chiral-ftp.app` below.
2. Drag it to Applications.
3. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time macOS says it can't
   check it: open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and choose
   **Open Anyway** (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine
   /Applications/chiral-ftp.app` once).

Updating: replace the app. Your settings stay in
`~/Library/Application Support/chiral-ftp`.

**Linux** (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 or newer, and others like them)

1. Download `chiral-ftp-1.1-aarch64.AppImage` (ARM computers, such as a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5 on 64-bit) or `chiral-ftp-1.1-x86_64.AppImage` (most PCs) below.
2. Make it executable (`chmod +x chiral-ftp-*.AppImage`, or Properties >
   Allow executing as a program) and run it.

Updating: replace the file. Your settings stay in `~/.local/share/chiral-ftp`.

**Windows** (Windows 10 or 11)

1. Download `chiral-ftp-1.1-windows-x64.exe` below (it runs on Windows on ARM PCs too, through Windows' own x64 emulation).
2. Run it; nothing needs installing. The program isn't signed, so the first
   time Windows SmartScreen says it doesn't recognise it: choose
   **More info > Run anyway**. When Windows Firewall asks, allow private
   networks, so that a console or phone can reach the server.

Updating: replace the `.exe`. Your settings stay in `%APPDATA%\chiral-ftp`.
To keep everything on a USB stick instead, settings included, make a folder
named `data` next to the `.exe`: chiral-ftp then keeps its settings there.

### Checksums


repos.description: MacheteSaveGameManager: PS5/PS4 save manager in active development. Cross-console PS5 saves via dummy injection (PS5 root keys unreleased). Share logs to improve compatibility.
repos.readme:
# MacheteSaveGameManager (PS5 & PS4 Savegame Manager & Web Save Station)

![MacheteSVG Banner](docs/screenshots/banner.png)

[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-PlayStation_5-blue.svg)](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager)
[![Firmware](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firmware-All_Jailbroken_Firmwares-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager)
[![Title ID](https://img.shields.io/badge/Title_ID-PPSA99700-informational.svg)](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL_v3.0-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v1.3.0-orange.svg)](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager/releases/tag/v1.3.0)

**MacheteSaveGameManager** (MacheteSVG) is a native PlayStation 5 homebrew application designed to back up and restore save data (*savegames*) for both PS5 native titles and PS4 backwards-compatible games with **100% reliability**, zero risk of data corruption (preventing errors `CE-108255-1` and `CE-107109-8`), cross-console PS5 Save Dummy injection, Apollo-style PS4 auto-resigning with savedata.db corruption repair, and an embedded high-speed **Web Save Station** HTTP server (:8383) featuring an **in-app QR Code** for instant one-scan access from any smartphone, tablet, or PC on your local Wi-Fi / LAN.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Active Development & Hardware Cryptography Disclosure**:
> - **Continuous Development:** MacheteSaveGameManager is in continuous active development to resolve issues as they arise and refine compatibility across titles.
> - **Compatibility Scope:** Full compatibility across all PS5 and PS4 titles is not guaranteed due to varying game engines, proprietary internal checksums, and custom archive formats.
> - **Log Sharing & Feedback:** If you encounter an issue with any title, please export your `machete.log` (available via the Web Save Station or at `/data/homebrew/PPSA99700/machete.log`) and share it with a description of the failure. Community reports allow us to study game-specific behaviors and expand compatibility.
> - **PS5 Cryptography Limitations (Foreign Saves):** PlayStation 5 root hardware cryptographic keys (SAMU keystore) remain private and unreleased in the scene. As a result, direct offline re-encryption of foreign PS5 saves is currently impossible on any tool. MacheteSaveGameManager overcomes this by mounting the container via kernel `/dev/pfsmgr` and hot-injecting decrypted data into an authentic local Save Dummy container sealed by your console's SAMU.

---

## English Documentation

### Interface Showcase & Screenshots

The user interface is powered by a custom hardware-accelerated OpenGL 4.6 SDF renderer that delivers a fluid 60 FPS "Liquid Glass" translucent design with dual-panel layout, real-time box art rendering, spring kinematics, and full DualSense controller audio and haptic support.

| English Dashboard (1080p Render) | PS5 Hardware Capture (Real Console) |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![English Dashboard](docs/screenshots/dashboard_english_1080p.png) | ![Real Hardware Dashboard](docs/screenshots/ps5_real_hardware_dashboard.png) |

| Web Save Station Dialog with QR Code | Modal Location Selector (Real Console) |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![Web Save Station](docs/screenshots/web_station_dialog_1080p.png) | ![Real Hardware Modal](docs/screenshots/ps5_real_hardware_modal.png) |

---

### Installation (Easy FTP Method)

1. Download `PPSA99700.zip` (or `MacheteSaveGameManager_v1.3.0_PS5.zip`) from [Releases](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager/releases).
2. Extract the ZIP archive on your computer to obtain the `PPSA99700` application folder.
3. Enable the FTP server on your PlayStation 5 (via OnionHEN, etaHEN, or your jailbreak payload).
4. Using an FTP client (FileZilla, WinSCP, Cyberduck, etc.), copy the entire `PPSA99700` folder directly into:
   ```
   /data/homebrew/
   ```
   The resulting path on your PS5 must be:
   ```
   /data/homebrew/PPSA99700/eboot.bin
   ```
5. Launch **MacheteSaveGameManager** directly from your homebrew launcher (Itemzflow, ProsperoStore, or system menu)!

---

### Core Architecture & Capabilities

#### 1. Zero-Corruption Save Architecture & Cross-Console Restoration
- **Cross-Console PS5 Save Dummy Injection:** Solves error `CE-107109-8` when restoring PS5 saves from another console or after a complete firmware reinstall. Uses `/dev/pfsmgr` to extract decrypted save files (`backup/decrypted/`). When restoring, it preserves the authentic local Save Dummy PFS container and safely hot-injects decrypted payload data into the mount point (`/data/save_mnt`), allowing the console kernel to seal the container with matching hardware keys.
- **Apollo-Style PS4 Auto-Resigning & Database Indexing:** Automatically patches 64-bit `ACCOUNT_ID`, `user_id`, and recalculates Sony `psid_hmac` inside `param.sfo` (both outer metadata and inner PFS container) while preserving the authentic `keystone` (96 bytes). Directly updates the system `savedata.db` to register the save and clear corruption flags (`is_broken = 0`, `fake_broken = 0`), completely eliminating "Corrupted Data" errors on PS5 backwards compatibility.
- **Keystone Cryptographic Preservation:** During save restore operations, console-specific identity files (`sce_sys/keystone` and `sce_sys/param.sfo`) are strictly preserved and never overwritten. Only the underlying save payload container (`data000.bin`) is replaced.
- **CE-108255-1 Prevention:** Unmounts save containers via clean `sceSaveDataUmount` system calls, allowing the Prospero kernel to seal and encrypt the PFS container without filesystem corruption.
- **Global vnode Flush (`sync()` / `fsync()`):** Atomic write operations followed by FreeBSD vnode cache invalidation guarantee that PS4 backwards-compatibility emulator caches reload restored save data instantly without requiring console reboots or game restarts.

#### 2. Embedded Web Save Station & In-App QR Code (:8383)
- **Local HTTP Web Server (:8383):** Integrated high-performance HTTP server running on dedicated port 8383 with automatic PS5 LAN IP detection. Runs on a dedicated background thread with 4 MB stack without blocking the 60 FPS UI.
- **In-App QR Code Generator (ISO/IEC 18004):** Built-in zero-dependency C++20 QR Code engine. Displays an instant scan-ready QR code in the Web Server modal dialog. Users simply scan the TV screen with their smartphone camera to open the Web Station without typing IP addresses.
- **Modern Dark Glassmorphism Web UI:** Responsive single-page web app (HTML5 / CSS3 / ES6) embedded directly inside the binary. Zero external CDN dependencies; 100% offline-ready.
- **Live Game Save Browser:** View installed games, real cover art, Title IDs, platform tags (PS5 / PS4), and save sizes from your phone or PC browser.
- **Instant ZIP Streaming:** Custom C++ streaming ZIP archive generator (IEEE 802.3 CRC32, Store mode) allowing one-click download of individual game saves or an entire library archive (`.zip`) with precalculated `Content-Length` for accurate browser progress bars.
- **Individual File Explorer:** Interactive modal to inspect files inside each save directory and download individual files (`param.json`, `sdimg_*`, `keystone`).
- **One-Touch Activation:** Toggle the server on/off via the top header badge or by pressing **Triangle** on your DualSense controller.

#### 3. Autonomous Sandbox Escape & Community Title ID Standard
- **Title ID `PPSA99700`:** Conforms to the community-established homebrew Title ID convention (`PPSA99xxx`, adopted by projects such as ProsperoStore `PPSA99000` and Machete AI Studio `PPSA99699`) to guarantee zero conflicts with retail PlayStation Store software.
- **Embedded Lapy Daemon:** Packages `lapy_jb_daemon.elf` directly within the application package (`/app0/lapy_jb/`).
- **Local ELF Loader Auto-Launch:** Connects autonomously to `127.0.0.1:9021` to trigger root privilege escalation (`ucred` credential elevation) through `/download0/etahen_jailbreak`. No manual third-party payload senders are needed.
- **Live Jailbreak Monitor:** Dynamic status indicator displaying root authorization status with automatic background retry logic.

#### 4. Internationalization (i18n) Engine
- **English Default:** All system prompts, error codes, and fallback dialogs default to English.
- **Automatic Language Detection:** Inspects console parameters through `sceSystemServiceParamGetInt`. Spanish systems automatically start in Spanish, while English and all other languages default to English.
- **Real-Time Language Switch:** Press **L3** (Left Stick Click) at any moment to switch instantly between English and Spanish.

#### 5. Storage Hierarchy
Backups follow an organized, sanitized filesystem layout across all supported media:
- **Internal Storage:** `/data/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Game Name]/`
- **M.2 Expansion SSD:** `/mnt/ext1/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Game Name]/`
- **External USB Media:** `/mnt/usb0/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Game Name]/`
- **Web Save Station:** Accessible from local browser at `http://<PS5-IP>:8383/` or via in-app QR code.

---

### Controller Navigation (DualSense)

| Button | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| **D-Pad Up / Down** | Navigate through installed game saves |
| **Cross (X)** | Confirm selection / Open backup destination picker |
| **Square** | Open restore source picker |
| **Triangle** | Toggle Web Save Station (LAN / Wi-Fi HTTP Server with QR Code) |
| **L3 (Stick Click)** | Instant language toggle (English / Spanish) |
| **Circle** | Cancel active dialog / Return to dashboard |

---

## Documentación en Español (Spanish Documentation)

> [!IMPORTANTE]
> **Aviso de Desarrollo Activo y Divulgacion Criptografica de PS5**:
> - **Desarrollo Continuo y Activo:** MacheteSaveGameManager se encuentra en desarrollo activo y constante para corregir incidencias que puedan surgir y perfeccionar la compatibilidad con cada actualizacion.
> - **Alcance de Compatibilidad:** No se garantiza compatibilidad al 100% con todos los titulos de PS5 o PS4 debido a particularidades en motores de juego, firmas internas y capas de cifrado propietario de cada desarrollador.
> - **Envio de Logs y Retroalimentacion:** Si encuentras un juego que no restaure o respalde correctamente, descarga el registro `machete.log` (disponible directamente con 1 clic desde la Estacion Web Local o en `/data/homebrew/PPSA99700/machete.log`) y compartelo junto con un comentario detallado del problema. Tu colaboracion permite estudiar la falla e incorporar soluciones especificas.
> - **Estado Criptografico de PS5 (Partidas de Otras Consolas):** Las claves maestras criptograficas de hardware de PlayStation 5 (SAMU keystore) aun no estan disponibles publicamente en la scene. En consecuencia, el recifrado directo offline de partidas de PS5 entre consolas distintas no es posible en ninguna herramienta. MacheteSaveGameManager sortea esta limitacion montando el contenedor mediante `/dev/pfsmgr` e inyectando en caliente los datos desencriptados dentro de un Save Dummy local autentico que el procesador SAMU de tu consola sella con sus claves legitimas.

### Galería de Capturas de Pantalla

La interfaz gráfica cuenta con un renderizador SDF sobre OpenGL 4.6 acelerado por hardware que funciona a 60 FPS fluidos con diseño translúcido "Liquid Glass", vista dividida, carátulas en tiempo real, física de resortes y respuesta sonora completa de DualSense.

| Panel Principal en Inglés (Render 1080p) | Captura de Hardware Real en PS5 |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![Panel en Inglés](docs/screenshots/dashboard_english_1080p.png) | ![Panel en Consola Real](docs/screenshots/ps5_real_hardware_dashboard.png) |

| Diálogo de Estación Web con Código QR | Selector Modal de Ubicación (Consola Real) |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![Estación Web Local](docs/screenshots/web_station_dialog_1080p.png) | ![Selector Modal](docs/screenshots/ps5_real_hardware_modal.png) |

---

### Instalación (Método Fácil vía FTP)

1. Descarga `PPSA99700.zip` (o `MacheteSaveGameManager_v1.3.0_PS5.zip`) desde la sección [Releases](https://github.com/VenezuelanBiggie24/MacheteSVG-PS5-Save-Manager/releases).
2. Extrae el archivo ZIP en tu computadora para obtener la carpeta `PPSA99700`.
3. Habilita el servidor FTP en tu PlayStation 5 (a través de OnionHEN, etaHEN o tu payload jailbreak).
4. Usando un cliente FTP (FileZilla, WinSCP, Cyberduck, etc.), copia la carpeta `PPSA99700` completa directamente en:
   ```
   /data/homebrew/
   ```
   La ruta resultante en tu PS5 debe ser:
   ```
   /data/homebrew/PPSA99700/eboot.bin
   ```
5. Inicia **MacheteSaveGameManager** directamente desde tu lanzador de homebrew (Itemzflow, ProsperoStore o menú principal).

---

### Arquitectura y Capacidades Principales

#### 1. Arquitectura con Cero Corrupción y Restauración Cross-Console
- **Inyección Cross-Console de Partidas PS5 con Save Dummy:** Soluciona el error `CE-107109-8` al restaurar partidas de PS5 provenientes de otra consola o tras formatear el sistema. Utiliza `/dev/pfsmgr` para extraer los archivos desencriptados (`backup/decrypted/`). Al restaurar, preserva el contenedor Save Dummy local auténtico e inyecta en caliente los datos desencriptados en el punto de montaje (`/data/save_mnt`), permitiendo que el kernel de Prospero selle el contenedor con las claves maestras locales de la consola.
- **Resignado Automático Estilo Apollo e Indexación en Base de Datos para PS4:** Modifica automáticamente el `ACCOUNT_ID` de 64 bits, actualiza el `user_id` y recalcula el `psid_hmac` de Sony en `param.sfo` (tanto externo como dentro de la imagen PFS), preservando el `keystone` original (96 bytes). Actualiza directamente la base de datos `savedata.db` del sistema eliminando las banderas de corrupción (`is_broken = 0`, `fake_broken = 0`) para que los juegos de PS4 en retrocompatibilidad reconozcan la partida de inmediato sin errores de "Datos dañados".
- **Preservación Criptográfica de Keystone:** Durante las operaciones de restauración, los archivos de identidad de la consola (`sce_sys/keystone` y `sce_sys/param.sfo`) se mantienen intactos y nunca se sobrescriben. Solo se actualiza el contenedor de datos (`data000.bin`).
- **Prevención del Error CE-108255-1:** Desmontaje limpio mediante llamadas `sceSaveDataUmount`, asegurando que el kernel de Prospero selle y cifre los contenedores PFS adecuadamente.
- **Vaciado Global de Caché vnode (`sync()` / `fsync()`):** Operaciones atómicas que invalidan las tablas de caché del emulador de PS4, permitiendo que las partidas restauradas se reflejen al instante sin reiniciar la consola.

#### 2. Estación Web Local Integrada con Código QR (:8383)
- **Servidor Web HTTP Local (:8383):** Servidor HTTP de alto rendimiento embebido en el puerto 8383 con detección automática de la IP local de la consola PS5. Corre en un hilo de fondo dedicado con 4 MB de pila sin afectar los 60 FPS de la interfaz.
- **Generador de Código QR en Pantalla (ISO/IEC 18004):** Motor QR nativo en C++20 sin dependencias externas. Renderiza un código QR limpio y escaneable en el diálogo del Servidor Web. El usuario simplemente apunta la cámara de su teléfono o tablet hacia la pantalla del televisor para entrar de inmediato a la Estación Web sin escribir IPs.
- **Interfaz Web Dark Glassmorphism:** Aplicación web moderna (HTML5 / CSS3 / ES6) integrada directamente en el binario sin enlaces a CDNs externos ni requerir conexión a Internet.
- **Explorador de Partidas en Vivo:** Visualiza tus títulos instalados, carátulas auténticas, Title IDs, plataformas (PS5 / PS4) y peso de datos de guardado desde cualquier navegador en PC o teléfono inteligente.
- **Transmisión de Archivos ZIP al Vuelo:** Generador streaming de archivos ZIP en C++ (IEEE 802.3 CRC32, modo Store) que permite descargar partidas individuales o la librería completa en un archivo `.zip` con barra de progreso real en el navegador gracias al cálculo anticipado de `Content-Length`.
- **Explorador de Archivos Individuales:** Modal interactivo en el navegador para explorar el contenido interno de cada partida y descargar archivos sueltos (`param.json`, `sdimg_*`, `keystone`).
- **Activación Rápida:** Enciende o apaga el servidor con un solo toque desde la cabecera superior o pulsando el botón **Triángulo** en el mando DualSense.

#### 3. Escape Autónomo del Sandbox y Convención de Title ID
- **Title ID `PPSA99700`:** Cumple con la nomenclatura comunitaria de homebrew (`PPSA99xxx`) para prevenir conflictos con títulos oficiales de PlayStation Store.
- **Demonio Lapy Incluido:** Integra `lapy_jb_daemon.elf` dentro de `/app0/lapy_jb/`.
- **Lanzamiento Automático:** Se conecta al cargador ELF local (`127.0.0.1:9021`) y solicita la elevación de privilegios root (`ucred`) a través de `/download0/etahen_jailbreak`. No se necesitan aplicaciones de inyección adicionales.
- **Monitor de Jailbreak:** Indicador dinámico de estado root con reintento automático en segundo plano.

#### 4. Motor de Internacionalización (i18n)
- **Inglés Predeterminado:** Todas las pantallas y mensajes de error inician por defecto en inglés para consolas de cualquier región internacional.
- **Detección Automática:** Verifica la configuración de la consola con `sceSystemServiceParamGetInt`. Si la consola está en español, inicia automáticamente en español.
- **Cambio en Vivo:** Pulsa **L3** en cualquier momento para alternar al instante entre inglés y español.

#### 5. Jerarquía de Almacenamiento
Estructura ordenada y compatible con sistemas de archivos FAT32/exFAT:
- **Almacenamiento Interno:** `/data/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Nombre del Juego]/`
- **SSD de Expansión M.2:** `/mnt/ext1/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Nombre del Juego]/`
- **Unidades USB:** `/mnt/usb0/MacheteSVG/[TitleID - Nombre del Juego]/`
- **Estación Web:** Accesible desde el navegador en `http://<IP-PS5>:8383/` o mediante el código QR en pantalla.

---

### Controles del Mando DualSense

| Botón | Acción |
| :--- | :--- |
| **D-Pad Arriba / Abajo** | Navegar entre las partidas guardadas |
| **Cruz (X)** | Confirmar selección / Elegir destino de respaldo |
| **Cuadrado** | Elegir origen de restauración |
| **Triángulo** | Activar Estación Web Local con Código QR (Servidor HTTP LAN/Wi-Fi) |
| **L3 (Click Stick)** | Alternar idioma al instante (Inglés / Español) |
| **Círculo** | Cancelar diálogo activo / Volver al menú |

---

latestRelease.body:
MacheteSVG v1.3.11 (Build #85)

### Decima Engine Root Save Correction
- Fixed PS5 primary slot selection to prioritize PROFILE when present on disk.
- Fixed Decima Engine boot detection (Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered, Death Stranding) by setting dirName to PROFILE with matching exact fileSize (6,291,456 bytes) and empty subTitle in savedata_prospero_meta/param.json.
- Prevented stale .meta_dummy from overriding authentic PROFILE metadata.
- Configured savedata.db free_blocks calculation to exactly allocate 24 free blocks for PROFILE (96 total blocks) and 48 free blocks for 192-block gameplay slots.

### PS4 Backwards Compatibility Clean Mirroring
- Excluded internal backup twin containers (sce_bu_*) from being indexed as standalone gameplay slots.
- Prevented invalid registration of sce_bu_* containers in savedata.db, resolving 'Datos no se pudieron cargar' in Dragon Quest XI S (CUSA18600).
- Automatic 1:1 mirroring of sealed active slots to backup twins (sce_bu_Book and sce_bu_Book.bin) upon commit.
- Purged orphan sce_bu_* rows from savedata.db during database synchronization.
